reviews.text: Staff always attentive and offering sound advice
Absolutely fantastic employee! Thank you for the click and collect service this evening :)
Pleasant welcome and courteous and friendly team, thank you very much

I usually buy my dog's food online. This store opened near my home, which is very convenient with click and collect. There's a wide selection, the prices are reasonable, and I'm very satisfied. The staff is friendly and helpful when I pick up my orders.
The staff is very welcoming and friendly, and they have a good selection of products. You can also accumulate points on a loyalty card. I recommend this store.
Excellent service and great quality products! Thank you

A top-notch team.
Always offering great advice and attentive to our needs.
Thank you to the whole team.
Thank you Inès for your professionalism and kindness! Top-notch grooming! I recommend you 100%!
Whether you want to spoil your pet, pamper it, spoil it, or simply feed it, you'll find everything you need here.
The staff are very welcoming, it's a shame that the store's "croq pro chat" brand products don't come from Europe... a real shame!
A lovely shop; you're sure to find what you're looking for, whatever your pet. The staff are very friendly and helpful.
Lovely staff, comprehensive selection, it's great! Thank you for your valuable advice. 🐶 …
A huge congratulations to Inès the groomer who did a fantastic job on Volt! She was all smiles, just like the rest of the team. Well done to you all, I'm so happy! 😻 …

I'm satisfied with it; however, parking is so difficult on Grande Rue de la Croix-Rousse! Luckily, we're from Croix-Rousse. During my last visit, I was informed that you had a groomer and I left my phone number so she could call me back, which she did, but to this day I haven't been able to reply to her message because neither of Animalis's phone numbers is working: we're told that the number is unreachable, or something like that!!!

1/52/53/54/55/5

My vet says it's...caviar! So I'm letting all my other cats eat it (I didn't dare let them eat the kibble meant for just one cat, because I thought Urinary/So was deficient).

1/52/53/54/55/5

A very wide selection, well presented, at internet prices if you register for free with their stores. The advice, welcome, and guidance are very friendly without being intrusive. All of this makes a difference compared to online retailers.

A very professional advisor,
Really good advice and a very warm welcome
Smiling, friendly saleswomen ♥️ Even if I can only spend once or twice a month, I feel just as valued as a regular customer. Thank you from PoZka and me 😎 …
Super friendly saleswoman ♡
I took my dog ​​to the groomer and I highly recommend her, she did a superb job! ☺️
My favorite store! Always full of things to discover and very professional and welcoming advisors.
A store that offers a very wide selection at very reasonable prices. Good service.
Very attentive staff. They were a great help in choosing things for our new pet. Competitive prices. I'd like to highlight their bilingual service.
Thank you to the very kind saleswoman on Sunday morning (March 15th). It was a pleasure to have someone so smiling and helpful. Thank you.
We always receive excellent advice during our visits. The staff is very attentive. Thank you and see you soon!
I took my dog ​​in for grooming and the work was impeccable. The young woman was very kind; I highly recommend her. The price was very reasonable.
The manager is passionate and gives excellent advice.
The salespeople are very friendly, we always receive a warm welcome.
I couldn't find a litter box that was the right size for me.

I'm not a regular customer, as I don't live in Lyon. Currently on vacation, I visited your store twice today, accompanied by my dog ​​and daughter, to buy various items (food, a collar, a bed, etc.). I wanted to emphasize the exceptional kindness of the staff, the impeccable cleanliness of the store, and the quality and variety of the products offered. Thank you so much for your warm welcome and the attention you gave my little dog. We'll definitely be back!
Nice and worth discovering the products
I was able to order an item and receive it very quickly. The sellers were very friendly, as always. Thank you to them.
Excellent staff. Clean and well-stocked store.
Great team! Thanks, that's really nice.
A great store. Very large, well-organized, and pleasant. The only slight drawback is that the "small rodents" section doesn't have a wide selection.
Very happy with my visit 😻, the seller is very competent and knows the products. …

I went there this afternoon, and I'm disappointed. I was looking for a brand of cat food for my cat who vomits and has diarrhea, and they offered me food that's completely unsuitable for my cat, who has a sensitive digestive system and loose stools.
When you go there because your cat has problems, you expect at least decent solutions, not just because you have a contract with the brand… Anyway, I'm used to Animalis stores, but this one isn't. I'm quite disappointed.

First grooming session for my Maine Coon: 10/10!
Inès took the time to reassure my cat and took perfect care of him!!
I recommend her 1000%!
Warm welcome, attentive salespeople

I found some average products at average prices. No complaints there.

However, there was absolutely no effort at the checkout to hide the prices or properly fold the clothes I'd bought. Instead of just throwing them in a ball, I should have found a bag.

Very pleasant welcome. However, the app indicates that there is aquarium equipment available, which isn't the case... hence the rating.

Plenty of items for dogs and cats.
A paradise for dogs and cats, but for other animals (rodents, for example) there's practically nothing on the shelves. A shame.
I received excellent advice and kind service from the staff.
Great location, spacious store, good selection of items and competitive prices.
Excellent service and customer relations, a very business-oriented team!

Great shop!

They have everything for pets.

I recommend it! 🇫🇷🇫🇷
Impeccable service, polite and lovely staff, I highly recommend them!!!
The staff are always attentive and available, which is very pleasant. Top-notch store! Thank you to the whole team!
Perfect place to find cat toys, a variety of foods, and pheromones at good prices and quality. They also have a good loyalty card.
A well-stocked shop for your pets. I was warmly welcomed by the manager and picked up my order. However, the young man working in the aisle didn't even say hello…

I came to this pet store to buy a water fountain, and I was delighted with the service! In addition to giving me excellent advice, the saleswoman took the time to give me a complete demonstration, explaining how the fountain works and how to care for it.

The store is clean, well-organized, and has a wide selection of products. The staff is both knowledgeable and friendly. A great experience; I highly recommend it!
Friendly customer service and staff, wide selection of products even though many more are available online.
Very convenient! I was thinking of going to MDA, but I ended up being drawn to this store. There's a lot of choice.
A very wide selection and excellent advice. They had even provided a small water fountain with cups during the heatwave.
I am sorry for the opinion I shared in Lyon 4 which was more about St Priest, regarding dog washing.
Awesome!
A pleasant and well-stocked store. The staff are helpful and attentive to customers. I recommend it!
Great service

What can I say… Except a huge thank you to Ms. Laetitia, who was incredibly professional and went out of her way to find me an item from another store and pick it up for me. Thanks to her, I received my item on time because, unfortunately, due to a delivery service that leaves much to be desired (DHL), I wasn't going to receive my item within 72 hours, but rather within a week. So thank you again, and I highly recommend this store. 👍🏻
Great, I recommend it!
Excellent welcome and advice!!! On my first visit I was greeted by the manager who is truly lovely.
Great selection of items for our furry friends.
It's a shame the team is sometimes absent or unpleasant
The team is very friendly and there is a wide selection of products.

I'm a big fan of the chain... a special mention to Vince. He's largely the reason I keep coming back to the Croix-Rousse location. His kindness, professionalism, and unfailing smile for every customer make it a store where it's a pleasure to shop. As for Lucas, always there, thank you for being, like Vince and Sarah, a benchmark for this store.

Lucas, I have...

I was automatically added to your mailing list, but I can't get rid of your daily promotional emails despite following the unsubscribe procedure and contacting your customer service directly (who assured me they had taken the necessary steps). I've filed a complaint with the CNIL (French Data Protection Authority), but I prefer to warn other consumers about your aggressive marketing practices.

A huge thank you to Vince, the manager, and Lucas for their warm welcome and expert advice. They are knowledgeable and trained (in pet supplies), a rare find in a chain like this. It's such a disappointment to learn of Vince's departure. Hopefully, a successor will be at least as capable.

The store has a wide variety of high-quality items. From classics like food and litter to more unusual items like carriers and scratching posts, there's something for everyone (especially our furry friends). My cat is glued to his scratching post and has never begged for wet food as much as since I started buying it here. I highly recommend it; the staff and manager are very friendly and always know how to advise me.
Happy cat!
Very friendly and helpful staff, a good variety of products.

I came this week for my cat and my little beagle, and I was greeted and assisted with great kindness and professionalism by Sarah and Lucas!
The store is very clean and has a wide selection. Furthermore, the loyalty program is extremely advantageous compared to other stores.
The sales staff are very professional. Special mention to Sarah, thank you again for her kindness and helpful advice!
The team is very welcoming and gives me excellent advice on food and cat litter. Thank you to Sarah and her colleague for the warm welcome they gave my little cat at the store.
Great selection for my cat. I recommend it.
Great store, my dogs love going there!
My elderly dog ​​has digestive problems, the saleswoman took it upon herself to decide what I should buy, unheard of, for me, she is my dog ​​and I pay for the products.

The store was well-stocked, but one of the salespeople couldn't find the item I showed him on my phone in the catalog, including the brand and all the dimensions. He was incompetent and clearly had trouble understanding the instructions provided. This man is completely useless in customer service. I found the item at home in two minutes; I hope I don't run into him again when I go to pick up my order.

We are very disappointed with the behavior of the groomer at Animalis who was supposed to take care of our dog.

We had requested a very specific haircut for our dog, but she completely refused, verbally abusing us!

And she refused to even take him.
She then cancelled the appointment that same day.
Unacceptable!

The website mentions that post-operative bodysuits are for sale in-store. This is not the case in practice!

The store is large enough to offer a wider variety of products, not just three aisles dedicated to pet food. Since this local service is unreliable, I'm turning to am@zone.
Very poor customer service
Incompetent and should be avoided.
The shop owner is nonexistent, the groomer is very nervous and unable to handle a 3-kilo Havanese. Prices are exorbitant. Avoid at all costs.
I received excellent service from Sarah, who took the time to advise me on the best product. Thank you!

Excellent service from Sarah, very pleasant and helpful.

The store is clean, well-organized, with a great selection. I recommend it!
The store is great, but Sarah is a dedicated employee and helped me a lot with any problems I encountered!
A very warm welcome from Sarah, smiling and pleasant… it was a lovely start to the day! My only slight concern is that the shelves aren't always very well stocked.

The sales staff are really efficient and helpful!

I ordered via click & collect and it was very efficient; it was ready two hours later, just as promised on the website!
The store offers a wide selection, which is really appreciated in the city.
Don't hesitate, I recommend it!
Very warm welcome

Since Animalis opened, I've regularly picked up cat litter for my cat using their click and collect service. I want to emphasize the exemplary professionalism of the staff, who always manage to find solutions if there's a problem with the delivery driver. Thank you for your efficiency and dedication!
Dynamic team... lots of products... Lucas and his colleague are very competent, friendly, and full of helpful advice.

After going there to buy a fountain that was actually out of stock, they accompanied me to the store to make the purchase with home delivery, and the manager made sure the fountain arrived safely. Thank you to him for his dedication and professionalism.

I went to get my dog ​​groomed. It was perfect and so much cheaper than downtown.

The store is large; you'll find everything you need there—a real find in the heart of the city.

The staff is very friendly and helpful. 👏👏
I went there yesterday; the store is very nice, although a little pricey. The salesperson was perfect, but anyone who's dissatisfied should go elsewhere...

“Animalis is truly an excellent pet store! The selection of products is varied and high-quality, but what makes all the difference is the staff. They are always charming, available, and attentive, ready to help and give personalized advice for the well-being of our pets. Thank you to the whole team for your kindness and professionalism! I highly recommend it.”

One of the staff members couldn't find the 15% discount I was supposed to receive. When I said I wouldn't be taking the product, there was no attempt to rectify the situation or offer a solution. It's a shame; the store lost a customer, and the internet gained one. From now on, I'll shop at Zooplus.

Update 29/10/2024: The Animalis team was understanding and finally applied the 15% discount. I'm satisfied!

I was really satisfied at first, but the more I visit, the more disappointed I become!

The staff really need to improve their product knowledge and their friendliness!

From my point of view, this pet store is great if you already know what you're buying; there's a really good selection.

As for advice, avoid it at all costs! No two salespeople say the same thing, which is quite annoying. Most of them really don't know anything.

As for prices, Animalis doesn't hold back... Almost 30% cheaper on ZooPlus for some brands...

Good
👍 …
It's a shame the prices are a bit high.
Good range of kibble, my dog ​​likes it.
